title: Data centers · classified installations (ICPE), Géorisques · points
description: Data centers that appear in France's register of installations classified for environmental protection (ICPE), as published by Géorisques, with the commune and a link to the register card of each installation. Presence in the register is a fact about the register: it is not a statement about the size of the site, and data centers below the register thresholds are not in it at all.

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: AIOT number of the installation in the register, kept as a string with leading zeros.

fields.name: name_public
fields.description: Name of the installation or of its operator as recorded in the register.

fields.name: commune_insee
fields.description: INSEE code of the commune of the installation.

fields.name: unit_id
fields.description: Department of the installation, see abf-boundaries.

fields.name: naf_code
fields.description: Division of the French activity classification (NAF) recorded in the register, two digits.
fields.null_meaning: The register gives no activity code for the installation.

fields.name: selection_rule
fields.description: Rule that selected the record: name (the name in the register contains a data-center term, such as data center or centre de données); operator_list (the operator is on the project's list of data-center operators; for operators with other lines of business, only when the name also points to a data center); site_list (the site is named as a data center in a public document of its operator).

fields.name: lon
fields.description: Longitude as published in the register (WGS 84).
fields.null_meaning: The register gives no usable coordinates for the installation.

fields.name: lat
fields.description: Latitude as published in the register (WGS 84).
fields.null_meaning: The register gives no usable coordinates for the installation.

fields.name: coord_source
fields.description: Origin of the point: georisques, the register itself.

fields.name: coord_precision
fields.description: Precision of the point. city for all records: the register does not state the precision of its coordinates.

fields.name: ref
fields.description: Address of the register card of the installation on Géorisques.

fields.name: checked_at
fields.description: Date and time of the build that set the record.

fields.name: checked_by
fields.description: Script that selected the record; the independent agent check is in the verification log.

known_gaps: Data centers are selected from the register by name, by a list of data-center operators, and by a list of sites named in public operator documents. Every selected record was checked by an independent agent against the register card and a public source; three records could not be confirmed and are not in the layer.

Two random samples of 10 records left out by the rules were checked for missed data centers. They found 3 and then 1, and the rules were extended to include them. The final rules leave out 193 records that could plausibly be data centers (NAF division 62 or 63, or an operator with other lines of business); 16 of them were checked and 177 were not. Based on the second sample, between 1.8% and 40.4% (95% interval) of those 177, roughly 3 to 72 records, may be data centers. Six records of that sample could not be settled, so this is a low estimate. The layer is a lower bound of the data centers in the register.

The register extract gives no status of the installation and no precision of the coordinates, so all points are shown at commune precision. For one listed installation (Digital Realty MRS3, Marseille) the register card shows "en fin d'exploitation".
Activity codes in the extract are two-digit NAF divisions, so the code 63.11Z (data processing and hosting) cannot be used to select data centers.
Classification headings (rubriques), the regime of the installation and its equipment are deliberately not published.

verification.method: Candidates are selected by script rules (name, operator list, site list). Every candidate was checked by an independent agent against the register card and a public source, and only confirmed records are published. A record is confirmed when the operator publicly states a data center in the same commune and the address matches, or the operator has a single site there, or the register name itself says data center. Missed data centers are checked on a random sample of the records the final rules leave out among those with NAF division 62 or 63 or an operator with other lines of business: 16 of these 193 records were checked.

automated_checks.description: SHA-256 of every input file was computed at the start and again at the end of the build; they match.
Columns of the CSV, GeoParquet and GeoJSON files equal fields[] in composition and order.
record_id is present and unique in all 43 records.
Every unit_id of the layer exists in the boundaries release (FRA ADM2).
Every point lies inside the bounding box of the country of the layer.
Records with coord_precision none have no coordinates; every other record has a longitude and a latitude in range.
Every record has a non-empty ref (reference to the source record).
No field of the layer, of its files or of its tiles carries a power, capacity, generator or load value.
